lesson.title: Insurance Basics
lesson.goal: Understand how insurance protects you from big, sudden costs.

cards.text: Insurance means paying a small amount regularly so a big, sudden cost does not fall on you alone. Prices are in {cur}.

voice.speak_text: Insurance means paying a small amount regularly so a big, sudden cost does not fall on you alone. Say next to continue.

cards.text: What is the regular payment for insurance called?

voice.speak_text: What is the regular payment for insurance called? A: a premium. B: a loan. C: a tip. Say A, B or C.
voice.correct_feedback: Correct. The regular payment is called a premium.
voice.incorrect_feedback: Not quite. The answer is A, a premium.

cards.text: Insurance turns a big surprise cost into small, planned payments.

voice.speak_text: Remember: insurance turns a big surprise cost into small, planned payments. Say next to finish the lesson.
